Mount Mono

Villa in Si Sunthon
HomeSaleMount Mono

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A boutique collection of eight single-storey four-bedroom pool villas in Thalang, northern Phuket, developed by The Attitude Club. Each villa has its own saltwater pool, smart-home features and ensuite bedrooms, with about 460-477 sqm of built area. Non-Thai buyers acquire via a 30-year renewable lease, per the source.

Mount Mono: key facts

  • Mount Mono is a pool villa in Si Sunthon, Phuket, developed by The Attitude Club Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 4 bedrooms, 460.2–476.9 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿36,900,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Bangtao Beach (15 min, driving); Boat Avenue (12 min, driving); Porto De Phuket (12 min, driving); Robinson Lifestyle (14 min, driving).
  • More projects by The Attitude Club in our catalogue: MONO Champaca.

Facilities & amenities

  • Private saltwater pool with lounge and sun deck per villa
  • 24/7 security and monitoring
  • Covered parking
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Smart home system
  • Fully equipped built-in kitchen
  • Ensuite bathrooms
  • Digital door lock
